ns2:course.label: Directed Research in Arch
ns2:course.description: (ARCH 398) Participation in on-going research projects which may include energy management, environmental perception, facilities development, building science, and other topics. May be repeated to a maximum of 8 hours. Students may register in different sections of this course to a maximum of 8 hours. Prerequisite: Approval of written proposal by instructor and Director of School.
